svg.title: Build detail from weighted layers
svg.desc: The four upper plots show gain^i times base noise at frequency times lacunarity^i, divided by the common weight sum 1.875, for i=0,1,2,3. The lower plot is the app’s four-octave fbm result, verified to equal the sum within floating-point precision. Seed 42, frequency 0.7, lacunarity 2, gain 0.5, y=0.37, z=0.81, amplitude 1. Every plot uses x in [−3,3] and output in [−0.4,0.4]. The fBm branch uses raw base noise, without the Gradient lesson’s factor 1.55.

g.text: Four contributions and their sum, sampled directly from the app’s fBm implementation.
Each layer is already divided by the same weight sum: 1 + 0.5 + 0.25 + 0.125 = 1.875
The four curves add to this normalized fBm
Seed 42 · y = 0.37, z = 0.81 · Lacunarity 2 · Gain 0.5 · Amplitude 1 · Shared vertical scale
